entries.contribution:
June was very surprised when she saw that I got categorized and issued a distributor pass 

Essentially a distributor is the person who every brand or manufacturer wants to speak with and every retailer wants to know 

They are the center controlling any supply chain 

Further clarifying with Tripp it made a lot of sense in hindsight why we have been able to throw our weight around along the supply chain when we do. 

We technically own 

- the legal for export and import clearance (_especially FDA compliance into USA_)

- the capital to stock inventory we find proposing 

- ⁠the relationships with both the supply (_manufacturer_) and demand side (_retailer and direct consumers_)

Throw in the authenticity of our distribution networks’ brand story, we end up with something that is hard for any of the partners along the supply chain to replicate and everyone covets for

And this was only possible because every parties interest were aligned in the same direction first via our core values which was then made tangible with our actively traded $TDG governance tokens

And with the application of network effects and virality backed into it via a DAO model, the compounding will only serve to drive the deepening and widening of our Web3 based distribution network
